_comment: wave 32 (reroute temporal_sequences from per-event to windowed aggregation): the per-event Functions/Meos/TemporalSequences op was wired-only and could never pass (a sequence accessor on a single instant errors 'must be of subtype sequence'). It is the SAME array-of-temporal shape as wave-31's temporal_segments, so it reroutes to the tgeoseqarray fold. The per-event op (4 files + 2 CMakeLists entries + parser case-switch + include) has been removed; the shared g4 TEMPORAL_SEQUENCES token is kept (inject_g4 skips it as present). Removes a wired-only irregularity. Probed green on v15 (wave31_probe.c: temporal_sequences on a windowed continuous sequence -> cnt=1 valid EWKB).

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_sequences (TSequence **) - the array of sequences of the windowed continuous trajectory, each as EWKB hex.
